id: title:Gilbert09:retry token refresh transport errors inline

review.posthog_relevance: Adds transient network failure recovery and exponential backoff to the Google Search Console connector's token refresh loop, potentially preventing immediate failure on transient transport errors.
review.reason: The implementation adds exception handling and an exponential backoff strategy for `TransportError` in the token refresh loop, alongside the necessary imports. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in reliability and recovery behavior for the Google Search Console connector.
